purpose: The architecture band of a product page: a horizontal section title with one large button, over a row of up to five tabs whose active tab draws its named diagram the full width of the frame. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'architecture-tabs', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `section-title`, `button`, `frame-box`, `media-tabs` and `diagram`. The tabs advance on a timer that pauses under the pointer or keyboard focus and never runs under reduced motion; that state is owned by `media-tabs`.
useWhen: To plot several architectures of one product, or one request across the platform, one diagram at a time.
avoidWhen: For features shown by an illustration each → use `feature-tabs`.
related: media-tabs` — the timed tab row this section renders through.
diagram` — the named architecture diagram each tab draws.
bestPractices: Keep to five tabs with `position` `top` or `bottom`, three with `left` or `right`; tabs past the limit are not rendered.
Give every tab a `diagram` from the diagram library and a stable `value`.
